name: Warden's Grip
description: Hold a blade the way the Wardens teach: as if it were on loan. One-handed weapons deal 10% more damage.

name: Quick Steel
description: Light attacks with one-handed weapons cost 15% less stamina.

name: Ringing Blow
description: Every strike lands like a struck bell. One-handed weapons deal 25% more poise damage.

name: Wide Sweep
description: Two-handed weapons deal 10% more damage.

name: Hafted Poise
description: The Order's stance: weight forward, unhurried. Your poise is raised by 15.

name: Bell-Swing
description: Heavy attacks cost 20% less stamina.

name: Fernhold Draw
description: Draw as the Woodfolk do, in one breath. Bows draw 15% faster.

name: Fletcher's Thrift
description: A quarter more of your arrows can be found and used again.

name: Steady Breath
description: Bows and crossbows deal 15% more damage.

name: Braced Stance
description: Stand where you were put. Stability while blocking is raised by 0.1.

name: Ready Answer
description: The parry window is widened by six hundredths of a second, which is longer than it sounds.

name: Broken In
description: Worn armour protects 10% better.

name: Second Skin
description: The bone agrees with you. Penalties from armour weight to dodging and noise are halved.

name: Quiet Step
description: Movement noise is reduced by 30%.

name: Light Fingers
description: Pickpocket chance is raised by 15 points. A Palm of the Quiet Hands would call this a start.

name: Unsaid
description: Sneak attacks multiply damage by one more. What is not seen coming is not mentioned afterward.

name: Fair Dealing
description: Buy for 10% less, sell for 10% more.

name: Loud Name
description: Your deeds travel 20% further. In Wickmere this is not vanity; it is anchoring.

name: Hedge-Wise
description: Potions you brew are 20% stronger.

name: Forager
description: Gather one more of every ingredient you pick.

name: Bitter Tongue
description: Poisons you brew are 30% stronger. The Vale does not sell these; it finds them.

name: Red Door
description: Each temper tier improves gear by 15% instead of 10%.

name: Thrifty Forge
description: Recipes and tempering use a quarter fewer materials, never fewer than one.

name: Ember-Keeper
description: Notes you write hold 25% more charge from every mote.

name: Deep Writing
description: Enchantments you write are 20% stronger.

name: Wind in the Chest
description: Maximum stamina is raised by 15.

name: Strong Back
description: Carry 20 more before the load slows you.

name: Roll Away
description: Dodges are safe for a twentieth of a second longer and cost 15% less stamina.

name: Warm Word
description: Kindling spells cost 15% less mana.

name: Mote-Catcher
description: Capture one more Ember Mote from every foe whose last warmth you catch.

name: Quieted
description: Hush spells cost 15% less mana.

name: Held Fast
description: Wards and snares last 30% longer. A sentence that refuses to end.

name: Tender
description: Mending spells heal 20% more.

name: Loud Company
description: What you call stays 30% longer. Named firmly enough, it does not want to leave.
